title: Great App, Poor Performance, Overpriced
body: I have been using this app to track my habits for over a year now. Since I track a lot with it, I use the paid version. The app is beautifully designed, intuitive, user-friendly and can do everything I need. Unfortunately, it becomes extremely slow over time, as it apparently can't cope with too many entries due to poor programming. On an iPhone 15 Pro, it now takes several seconds to add a single entry. Unfortunately, restarting the device or reinstalling the app doesn't help. This is absolutely unacceptable for a price of 60 euros/dollars per year. For these reasons, I have to look for an alternative and cannot recommend the app to anyone who wants to use it over a longer period of time. For free use with only a few entries, it is perfectly fine.

title: Very nice App
body:
I got the premium version of this app and like it very much! It’s exactly what I was searching for. :) it’s super easy to set up, looks nice and you see a few statistics about your habits. 

What could be nice to have: 
- schedule something biweekly… like every other Sunday.

title: Very unintuitive UX/Ui, Bugs all over the Place.
body:
1) Navigation within the app is relatively slow and unintuitive.

2) Buggy tracking: 
if ‘Day start’ is set past 00:00, logged habits register as 12:00 of the previous day

3) very limited features: Logging and commenting is everything you can do?

4) really bad Widget

5) limited visualizations

Suggested functions to add or improve:
- Different variations of the same habit
- Better navigation within the App (!!!)
- Make better widget
- improve analytics and visualizations:
Allow grouping, adding tags and filters, overlapping visualizations, other chart types (distributions etc.), predictive analysis and pattern recognition using machine learning

-Was mir an Done gefällt, ist die klare und übersichtliche Tagesübersicht.

title: Nice concept, best app of its kind I've seen with room for improvement though
body:
It's seems a workable approach to track recurrent micro-tasks, both positive and negative. 

I find the sounds distracting from real work and the design is too playful - takes way to many clicks for many things. E.g. there should be a way to increment a task on the launchscreen of the app instead having to open the task. Also the reminders need improvement. For example, there is no way to remind me to drink if I haven't done so in say 2 hours. Needs conditional more fine-grained reminders. Also iCloud backup should be automatic cross-device instead of manually.
